questions.question: How do Bundler and the Gemfile work together?
questions.title: Bundler and the Gemfile
questions.direct_answer: The Gemfile lists the gems you want; Bundler resolves compatible versions and installs them, recording the exact versions in Gemfile.lock. Workflow: add a gem line to the Gemfile (gem 'sidekiq'), run bundle install (which resolves, installs, and updates the lock), commit BOTH Gemfile and Gemfile.lock, and run your app with bundle exec. The Gemfile is your intent (what you want, with version constraints); the lock is the resolved reality (exact versions). If two gems need conflicting versions, Bundler reports a conflict and you resolve it by loosening a constraint.

interviewer_intent.testing: Whether you know the Gemfile is intent (constraints) and the lock is the resolved reality (exact versions), and the workflow (add, bundle install, commit both).
interviewer_intent.common_mistake: Committing the Gemfile without Gemfile.lock (others resolve differently), or editing the lock by hand (Bundler owns it).
interviewer_intent.to_stand_out: Gemfile = intent (gem + constraint); Gemfile.lock = resolved exact versions. Add to Gemfile, bundle install, commit BOTH, run with bundle exec.

```ruby
# 2) Resolve and install (updates the lock)

# 3) Commit BOTH files together

# 4) Run with the locked versions

```
